description: The link to the TF Rooms reservation page on tfrooms.com, in English and Spanish, where a guest looks up or cancels an existing reservation by entering its reservation number and the last four digits of the contact phone. This connector does not read, look up or cancel a reservation, and preparing the link sends nothing. Cancellation on the page needs a six-digit code emailed to the booking address and is available more than 48 hours before the 3 PM check-in during office hours; other cancellations are made by phone with the property. The published cancellation policy applies; no payment or refund is processed. Returns the page link with the client's source label, the cancellation policy link and the New Leaf office phone and hours.
name: get_reservation_link
title: Reservation look-up and cancellation link
